insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address of an unfulfilled order is updated. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to API version 2026-10 and later.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware of this change, as it may affect their application's tax calculation logic. They should test their implementation to ensure it handles the updated tax calculations correctly. Additionally, developers should review their code for any dependencies on the previous tax calculation behavior and update it accordingly. The orderUpdate mutation is part of the GraphQL Admin API, which is used in various Shopify applications, including those built with Hydrogen and Remix/React Router.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate tax calculations, which can help reduce errors and improve the overall customer experience. This change can also help merchants comply with tax regulations more effectively.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid errors and potential legal issues. This update ensures that Shopify's tax calculation logic is up-to-date and reliable, providing a better experience for both merchants and customers.

updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, improving order management capabilities.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, making it easier for developers to achieve Built for Shopify status.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, improving trust and confidence in collaborator access.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data and storefront functionality

themes.title: ShopifyQL Enhancements
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.

themes.title: Storefront and UI Extensions
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, with the updateCart standard action updating cart attributes and a new shopify:cart:attributes-update event firing when an attributes update is initiated. Serve UI extension source maps are also now available during app development.

actions.text: Update analytics apps to use ShopifyQL for Shop Campaigns performance data
Test and implement cart attribute updates in storefront apps
Update to CLI version 4.6.1 for UI extension source maps
